exposure: Delivery location (public facility, private facility, home)
Mother's perceived birth size of the baby
cohort: 13,695 recently delivered women with a live birth outcome in 10 districts of Bangladesh
finding: The prevalence of SSC is very low in the surveyed districts of Bangladesh, with public facility delivery, private facility delivery, higher number of ANC visits, smaller perceived baby size, higher maternal education, and higher household wealth quintile being positively associated with SSC practice.
mod_finding: Caesarean section had a significant negative association with SSC practice compared to vaginal births.
